verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions a Skills API and a specification.md for the SKILL.md file format (agentskills.io), but neither is an OpenAPI or machine-readable API spec for the Skills API itself — no OpenAPI/JSON/YAML spec download is documented anywhere in the pack. The axis applies since Skills exposes an API surface (Messages API container parameter, Skills API endpoints), but no evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec for it.
